name: Newmarket–York University
description: Direct weekday bus from Newmarket to York University’s Keele campus through Aurora, Oak Ridges, King City and Maple. The shared timetable’s rail comparison columns are not bus stops.

timeline.event: The original timetable documents weekday Newmarket–York University service through King City and Rutherford.
The contemporary account quoted by York University reports that route 64 had permanently stopped operating.

gaps: The exact final operating day and original launch date have not been confirmed from an operator timetable or notice.
These are documented dated snapshots. Changes between snapshots, temporary diversions and every historical local stop have not all been recovered.
Manually reconstructed versions generally contain published timetable timing points / major stops. They must not be read as complete roadside stop inventories.
